explication: LVGL is a portable embedded UI library. An application creates a widget/object tree, configures its presentation and layout, accepts input, and renders the interface to a display. The graph preserves documented capabilities such as data binding, multiple displays, 2D/3D and vector rendering, text and image support, and hardware/OS integrations. Several subsystem paths are supported by the tree and README but were not sampled; those relationships are omitted or marked unverified rather than presented as inspected call paths.
